To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the Planetary Nervus System is a techno-social system for collective awareness, capable of answering questions about social complexity, and that the key ingredients of such a system are: social sensing, trusted network, and privacy-aware data mining.
the PNS will enable the creation of a global knowledge discovery framework for the analysis of the pulse of global social complexity.
the PNS is a techno-social system that is able to sense and mine the big data of human activities and unveil the knowledge hidden in it, to address the big questions about society.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design, the development and the deployment of the PNS for the purpose of social mining and collective intelligence.
the development of the science of social sensing and the art of social mining, and of the technology for building trusted networks and privacy-aware systems for social mining.
the design and implementation of a new generation of social sensing, mining, and analysis methods and technologies for building the PNS.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the Planetary Nervus System is a research roadmap for building a global-scale techno-social system for social mining of the big data for collective awareness.
the PNS represents the first step towards an integrated approach of social sensing and mining for collective awareness.

the PNS is a new kind of techno-social system for collective awareness and social mining, able to answer analytical requests about the pulse of the world, based on three main pillars: social sensing for harvesting the big social data; social mining for extracting the knowledge hidden in big data; and trust networks and privacy awareness for empowering users with full awareness and full control of their data.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the PNS is an ecosystem for social mining, where social sensing and trusted network are the infrastructure, while the analytical request is the goal, and the mining process is the way to achieve it.
the PNS is the missing link between the social web and the social science.

the PNS aims at creating a global, distributed, self-organized, and self-aware techno-social system for sensing, mining, learning and analyzing the big data about human behaviour, to unveil the knowledge hidden in them, to answer the big questions of social complexity, and to provide a new deal about privacy and data ownership.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we can build a PNS that is capable of answering analytical questions about global society by harvesting and mining the big data of human activities.

we are not only facing a technological challenge but a new paradigm of science, which will require a new generation of scientists, engineers, and social scientists, able to work in an interdisciplinary environment.
the PNS will provide an unprecedented level of knowledge discovery, by means of a novel combination of social sensing, social network analysis, data mining, and trusted network technology.
